context_title:
I want to create an app like Perplexity, but in such a way that it does not display the original models. Instead, multiple models should work together each time, and the system should display the model under a single name: Jade.
I want it to be much more intelligent, not just searching and reading 10–30 sources and answering like Perplexity, but even thousands if necessary. It should truly be intelligent: not only looking at the same sources that every regular AI app does. For example, if I search for something, it should research, decide, figure out what to search for, where to search, in multiple steps; it should infer, evaluate, think, doubt, inquire, etc. And if necessary, it should be able to research autonomously for hours.

What I have: Cerebras models (of course I would use the most advanced ones), so GPT oss 120b and Qwen 3,from xai Grok 4 and 4-fast API,and from exa is Exa AI API,

And I want a fully designed iOS-native app and PWA with the same look and feel as the Apple MacBook Pro and iPhone Air websites.

give me 2 file
one is the full backend another is the frontend Deliver the entire codebase for Replit. It must run instantly and error-free. Do not change original logic, only fix errors. No simplified, mock, placeholder, dummy, todo, simulated, or fake content. Provide all files in full, unshortened, production-ready code. No comments or extra messages.
